d:
CJP co-convenor Saurav Das has accused the government of trying to intimidate young voices after he was stopped from travelling to the United Kingdom, where he was scheduled to speak at institutions including Oxford.
Das alleged that the move was intended to send a message to other young activists and claimed the authorities were targeting him because of his association with the Cockroach movement. He also said the movement would continue despite what he described as attempts to silence dissent.
Thank you for watching our video!
